reviews.review_msg: in his sociology of art course, mr teeple spent much time expounding upon his antiquated belief that european culture is vastly superior to (and he specified) first nations art forms, east indian and middle eastern cultures and religions, among others.

Honestly, one of the best classes I've taken. Dany is amazing—she actually shares her own research with us. We spent time analyzing a real prison record! So much better than just reading theory. I really wish more profs taught like this. Highly recommend!

Taking Dany's class was the best eye-opening experiences I've had at SFU. Right from day one, you realize this isn't going to be one of those "sit back and take notes while the prof drones on" type of class. She has this incredible energy that makes the material feel urgent and actually relevant to your own life. She's fair and approachable.

If you're looking for a sign to take this class, this is it. Dany is a gem! Her seminars were the highlight of my week: they're so dynamic. She doesn't just stand there and talk at you.She has this way of inviting everyone to participate without it feeling scary. She is fair, cares for your success and makes the material interesting. Don't hesitate
